# Maryland's DOT  GIS Open Data Portal

![MDOT Logo](https://geo.sha.maryland.gov/images/maryland_MDOT_logo_Color_White_large_transparent%20background300.png)

![](https://data-maryland.opendata.arcgis.com/pages/mdot)

Easily search for the latest data and geospatial content from MDOT and the entire State of Maryland. Search for data using keywords or geographic location to discover and quickly display content. MDOT and the entire State of Maryland is committed to being open, transparent and providing data that's openly accessible and usable by all.

[![Home](https://mdgeodata.md.gov/AGOL_Graphics/DataCatalog20/Home.png)**Home**](https://data-maryland.opendata.arcgis.com/pages/mdot)

MDOT's interactive mapping applications are constructed to provide simple, focused access to information and tools for citizens to visualize and analyze MDOT data. We recommend exploring the interactive maps below for helping engage around specific goals and initiatives.

MDOT's six-year capital investment program for major transportation projects per the Consolidated Transportation Program (CTP).


# Featured Open Datasets

MDOT's featured open datasets are some of our more popular datasets MDOT has published in Maryland's GIS Data Catalog. Additional MDOT and State of Maryland data layers can be found via the "Search for Data" and/or "Search by Location" dialogs located at the very top of this page.

[Explore More Open Datasets](https://data-maryland.opendata.arcgis.com/pages/mdot-data)

- ![Card Thumbnail](https://geo.sha.maryland.gov/images/thumbnails/TC.PNG)





[Data](https://data-maryland.opendata.arcgis.com/search?collection=Dataset&q=aadt&tags=mdot%2Caadt)



Linear and point features specifically show the amount of annual average daily traffic (AADT), annual average weekday traffic (AAWDT), and AADT based on vehicle class (current year only) for public roadways


- ![Card Thumbnail](https://geo.sha.maryland.gov/images/Thumbnails/NPDES.PNG)





[Data](https://data-maryland.opendata.arcgis.com/search?collection=Dataset&q=npdes&tags=mdot%20sha)



MDOT SHA's National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) simplified data consisting of SWMFAC, Conveyance and Structures across the State of Maryland


- ![Card Thumbnail](https://geo.sha.maryland.gov/images/thumbnails/RSI.PNG)





[Data](https://data-maryland.opendata.arcgis.com/datasets/mdot-sha-roadway-sign-inventory)



MDOT SHA Roadway Sign Inventory data consists of point geometric features which represent the geographic locations of signs along MDOT SHA maintained roadways throughout the State of Maryland


- ![Card Thumbnail](https://geo.sha.maryland.gov/images/thumbnails/BLTS.PNG)





[Data](https://data-maryland.opendata.arcgis.com/datasets/maryland::maryland-bicycle-level-of-traffic-stress-lts/explore?location=38.840132%2C-77.259999%2C8.95)



Maryland Bicycle Bicycle Level of Traffic Stress (LTS) data consists of linear geometric features which showcase the bicycle level of traffic stress (LTS) along roadways throughout the State of Maryland.


# Featured Printed Maps

Many of MDOT's traditional map products are available for viewing, printing and downloading and in some cases ordering of hard copies online. These maps display a range of information, including roadways, administrative boundaries, traffic and truck volume in addition to many other features. The State of Maryland Official Transportation Map (English and Spanish versions) along with Maryland's Bicycle Map are available for free per the "Order Printed Maps" link below.

# **Data**

The Geographic Information Office (GIO) strives to meet the needs of our customers by providing everyone with the best possible data available. Through collaboration with our partners, we have been able to provide access to a large collection of data via MD iMAP that can be leveraged for use in many applications and analyses.

![samples of data on various devices](https://maryland.maps.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/36879e5c31ad4db4a85c3512d1cd3cdd/data)

## **Open Data**

Maryland publishes a wide range of datasets, both geospatial and non-geospatial, that can be quickly searched, displayed, and downloaded through centralized catalogs. This authoritative data, can be downloaded in multiple formats and access via APIs for use locally or in web applications.

### **GIS Data Catalog**

Quickly search for the latest data and geographic content from Maryland contributors. Use keywords or geographic searches to find and quickly display content.

[Go to the GIS Data Catalog](https://data.imap.maryland.gov/)

### **Open Data Portal**

Numerous, additional geographic and non-geographic data sets are available for search. Built-in tools allow for visualization of the data in a table, graph, or map format.

[Go to the Open Data Portal](https://opendata.maryland.gov/)

[Request an Open Data Account](https://imap.maryland.gov/pages/open-data-account-request)

![Aerial image of the Maryland State House](https://maryland.maps.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/49dde738969f4a64b583a24b929f16df/data)

## **Current and Historic Imagery**

Aerial imagery is an essential dataset for use in geospatial analysis and for giving 9-1-1 dispatchers the proper context in the event of an emergency call.

There are several kinds of data available through MD iMAP. These include:

- High Resolution Orthoimagery
- NAIP Imagery
- Storm-related Imagery
- Historic Color Infrared Imagery
- Historic Panchromatic Imagery

[Go to the Imagery page](https://imap.maryland.gov/pages/imagery-overview)

![Shaded Relief of Central Maryland](https://maryland.maps.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/d7afd8ad5b2a43cd9f2ca9ff9bdad8ca/data)

## **LiDAR and Derived Products**

Elevation data is essential for a broad range of applications, including flood risk management, ortho rectification, emergency management, damage assessment, viewshed analysis, and natural resource conservation management. Elevation data is collected through Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR). Maryland provides a complete collection of State and County products and services for elevation analysis.

The Maryland LiDAR server has been created to provide open access to statewide elevation information for use in a variety of studies and applications. The Maryland LiDAR server maintains the best available elevation data and provides image services in both county and statewide extents.

[Go to the LiDAR page](https://imap.maryland.gov/pages/lidar-overview)

![Data Resources graphic](https://geodata.md.gov/images/dataresources_icon_small.png)

## **Data Resources**

In addition to the data provided through the Geographic Information Office, other organizations within and outside of Maryland, at the state, regional, municipal, county, and federal levels of government, provide a wealth of data for use. Through great partnerships, we've compiled and shared many of those resources here for your exploration and use.

Additional resources are also available that highlight existing data through web mapping applications. The [Maryland State Geographic Information Committee](https://msgic.glueup.com/org/msgic/about/) (MSGIC) and the [GIO Office](https://imap.maryland.gov/pages/about-gio) strive to share this information and resources with the GIS community.

[Go to the Data Resources page](https://imap.maryland.gov/pages/data-resources)
